lessons.title: School and studies
lessons.learn: المستقبل القريب بـ سوف / سـ والحديث عن الامتحان.

grammar.title: سـ / سوف + المضارع
grammar.explain: خطة قريبة بعد سـ أو سوف.

examples.en: I'm going to revise tonight.
She's going to miss the lecture.
Are you going to finish the homework?

mistakes: لا تجمع سـ وسوف على الفعل نفسه.
بعد سـ يأتي المضارع لا الماضي.

dialogue.en: Have you got an exam tomorrow?
Yes, history. I'll revise after class.
Shall we study in the library?
Yes. The notes deadline is today.

grammar.title: أحبّ أنْ + المضارع
grammar.explain: بعد أنْ يبقى الفعل مضارعا منصوبا.

examples.en: I like playing guitar.
She doesn't like waiting.

examples.t: هَلْ تُحِبُّ أنْ تَرْسُمَ في العُطلة؟
examples.r: hal tuḥibbu an tarsuma fī al-ʿuṭla?
examples.en: Do you like drawing at weekends?

mistakes: لا تقل أحبّ أعزف بلا أنْ.

dialogue.en: What do you do at the weekend?
I play guitar. There's a concert on Saturday.
I like drawing. Are you coming?
Yes, after practice.

grammar.title: إذا + الماضي/المضارع

examples.en: If it rains, we'll cancel the picnic.
If the forecast is good, we'll walk.

examples.t: إذا لَمْ يَصْفُ نَبْقى في الدّاخِل.
examples.r: idhā lam yaṣfu nabqā fī ad-dākhil
examples.en: If it doesn't clear up, we'll stay inside.

mistakes: لا تضع سـ داخل إذا بلا حاجة.

dialogue.en: The forecast says showers.
If it rains, we'll go to the museum.
Take an umbrella anyway.
If it clears up, we'll walk by the river.
